construct: MEN1 encodes menin, a nuclear tumor-suppressor protein involved in transcriptional regulation, chromatin modification, DNA replication/repair, and restraint of cell proliferation. Germline loss-of-function variants predispose to multiple endocrine tumors, especially primary hyperparathyroidism, pituitary adenomas, and gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors.
